name: Question 4
problem:
The matrix $F$ and the vector $b$ are given below. Determine if $b\in \text{Col}(F).$ In the affirmative case, find the value of ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}$, where ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ are real numbers such that $b={x}_{1}{f}_{1}+{x}_{2}{f}_{2},$ and ${f}_{1},$  ${f}_{2}$ are the respective columns of $F.$

$$
F=[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 \\ 3 & 1\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 1\end{aligned}]
$$
worked_solution:
In order to determine whether $b$ lies in $\text{Col}(F),$ we need to check if the equation $Fx=b$ is consistent. So, let's find the row echelon form of the augmented matrix $[F\,|\,b]$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[F\,|\,b] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 5 \\ 3 & 1 & 1\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-3){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & -2 & 5 \\ 0 & 7 & -14\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}-2{x}_{2}=5 \\ 7{x}_{2}=-14.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second equation we get ${x}_{2}=-2.$ Substituting into the first equation gives  ${x}_{1}=1.$ 

Since we have a solution, the equation $Fx=b$ is consistent, which implies that $b\in \text{Col}(F).$

Moreover, there is exactly one solution, so we have exactly one way to write $b$ as a linear combination of ${f}_{1}$ and ${f}_{2}:$

$$
{{[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{b}=1\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 3\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{f}_{1}}+(-2)\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{f}_{2}}
$$

Finally, we get ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}=1\cdot (-2)=-2.$
